definitions.explanation: Short for {職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}, a public employment office where job seekers register, receive counseling, and apply for unemployment benefits. Commonly known as ハローワーク.

examples.japanese: {安定所|あんていじょ}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to the employment office.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{安定所|あんていじょ}で{仕事|しごと}を{紹介|しょうかい}してもらった。
examples.english: My father got a job referral at the employment office.

examples.japanese: {失業|しつぎょう}{保険|ほけん}の{手続|てつづ}きをするために{安定所|あんていじょ}を{訪|たず}ねた。
examples.english: I visited the employment office to file for unemployment insurance.

notes:
Abbreviation of {職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}. In everyday speech, the English-derived name ハローワーク is more common; {安定所|あんていじょ} appears in formal documents and conversation among older speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安定所|あんていじょ}に{通|かよ}う: to make regular visits to the employment office
- {安定所|あんていじょ}で{相談|そうだん}する: to consult at the employment office
- {公共|こうきょう}{職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}: public employment security office (full official name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハローワーク: the common, branded name for the same offices
- {人材|じんざい}{紹介|しょうかい}{会社|がいしゃ}: private staffing agency — fee-based, often for white-collar jobs
